headline: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start vs. Browns
summary: The Ravens have ruled quarterback Lamar Jackson out for a second straight week, elevating Tyler Huntley to the starting role for Sunday's game in Cleveland.

headline: Falcons' Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) cleared to play vs. Bears
summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr., who left last week's game with injured ribs, has been fully cleared to play against the Bears on Sunday.

headline: Mike Macdonald on Sam Darnold: He's definitely part of the solution
summary: It's been a rough stretch for Sam Darnold since he returned from a hip injury suffered in the season opener.

headline: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. to return vs. Patriots; RB Hall, WR Mitchell out
summary: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will play against the Patriots, but running back Breece Hall and wideout Adonai Mitchell have been ruled out for Sunday's game.

headline: Jaguars rule out LS Ross Matiscik, CB Montaric Brown
summary: The Jaguars won't have to scramble for a long snapper this weekend.

headline: Browns WR KC Concepcion clears concussion protocol, will play vs. Ravens
summary: Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion has cleared the concussion protocol and will play against the Ravens.
